original_test_intent: Change one approved BMC LAN channel to a valid static address/mask and then DHCP, verify field state and management reachability for both modes, and restore the exact original network configuration.
original_method: Use App 0x0C/0x01 selectors 0x04 source, 0x03 address and 0x06 mask through in-band and OOB paths, cross-check with lan print, then select DHCP; source example uses 192.168.6.123/16.
manual_activity: Network/FAE owner approves the channel, Project-valid static values, DHCP infrastructure, change window, conflict policy, recovery path and restoration end state.
safety_requirements: Never alter only reachable interface without recovery
Apply one selector transaction at a time
Expect session drop after address/source change
Do not change gateway/VLAN/ARP/alerts/security without separate approval
agent_execution_scope: Present exact static and DHCP sequence
Apply approved source/address/mask through each required path
Read back fields and verify reachability/lease
engineer_actions: Approve address plan and maintenance window
Recover lockout and own final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek recognizes the high risk but is inaccurate that exact bytes are wholly absent; the source supplies selectors/examples that still require Project validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, use a protected transactional LAN runner with Project-specific channel/values, selector-level readback, reachability/lease checks and complete baseline restore; never copy the example address blindly.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All raw commands, example IP/mask, static-to-DHCP order, in-band/OOB checkpoints, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved as source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a recovery-backed baseline-static-readback-reachability-DHCP-readback-restore workflow with network ownership checks and selector-specific evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Qualifies source addresses as Project inputs and adds conflict, lease, complete restore and independent recovery controls without dropping functional coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: lan print alone is not equivalent to performing and verifying both static and DHCP transitions; a read-only inventory does not satisfy this case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel/value can cause IP conflict or management lockout; OOB sessions commonly drop mid-change, so ambiguous completion must be resolved from the independent path rather than retried.

project_override_considerations: A vendor/Redfish network API may replace a transport only with engineer approval and equivalent static/DHCP field changes, in-band/OOB coverage accounting, readback, reachability/lease and exact restore evidence; original raw-tool coverage remains explicit if skipped.
expected_evidence: Redacted per-selector static responses and readback
Exact complete baseline restore and recovery validation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The static then DHCP procedure and Criteria align. The hard-coded address is a source example requiring Project validation, not an internal contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The LAN-change purpose and raw selectors are explicit. Channel, address plan, DHCP, recovery and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Retains full static/DHCP functional coverage while preventing example-address reuse, untracked selector drift, blind retry after session loss and permanent management lockout.
independent_technical_reasoning: Changing the address or source can terminate the very OOB session carrying the command, so lack of a response does not prove failure. Each transition must be evaluated from an independent recovery path, and the complete LAN baseline—not only source/IP/mask—must be captured to detect collateral parameter changes and support exact restoration.
